name: Krusch Harness MCP
description: PostgreSQL-backed coding and staged execution harness that stages diffs, runs sandboxed verification, and commits working-tree writes via a two-phase commit (2PC) apply journal. Status, diff, and diagnostic reads inherit Guard policy; task execution, diff apply, rejection, and abort require review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Use krusch_task_status, krusch_diff, and krusch_explain to inspect staged unified diffs, verification runs, and blocker diagnostics before applying any changes.
Keep autoApprove=false on krusch_run so staged diffs pause at APPROVAL_GATE and require explicit review via krusch_apply_diff before touching the working tree.
Keep krusch_apply_diff, krusch_reject, and krusch_abort on Review: krusch_apply_diff writes staged modifications to disk via the 2PC apply journal.
